mathematical_definition: sqrt(clip(overnight_var + k*open_var + (1-k)*rs_var, 0, None)) over a trailing 20-bar window, where overnight_var = causal_rolling_var(log(o/c_{t-1}), ddof=1), open_var = causal_rolling_var(log(c/o), ddof=1), rs_var = causal_rolling_mean(per-bar Rogers-Satchell), and k = 0.34/(1.34 + (window+1)/max(window-1,1)) -- Yang-Zhang volatility estimator, IS sqrt'd (true std, unlike gk_vol/rs_vol), combines overnight jump variance with drift-independent intrabar variance
numerical_stability_notes: overnight_var uses min_periods=2 (pandas rolling var ddof=1); result clipped at 0 before sqrt
missing_value_policy: NaN for windows with fewer than 20 observed bars (min_periods=2 on the overnight-var component), never zero-filled
